title: Forced Reconnection in Voigt-Regularized MHD
abstract: Forced reconnection in Voigt-regularized MHD is investigated in the Hahm-Kulsrud-Taylor problem. It is shown that Voigt regularization introduces an early linear phase of reconnection that partially bypasses the ideal current sheet formation phase. Three distinct regimes of Rutherford-like island growth and saturation are elucidated, including the braking effects of regularization and viscosity. It is conjectured, with numerical justification, that the inclusion of drag in the momentum equation does not inhibit the relaxation to steady state in the long-time limit.
